The Guardians They cast Berserk on Wendigo (it then throws only its plain punch and never raises its arms), cure its blindness with Eye Drops, throw Blizzara and Thundara for about 250 to 330, and drink a potion for 1,000 when hit. While its arms are up they Berserk your party. When one falls it casts Protect on Wendigo, the other Shell, unless it was turned to stone.
